content.comment_body: Hello, Is it possible to work with floating-point numbers in a [product_name] program? I'm using [product_name] ([product_name] V8.3.0). For example, when calculating 10/3 = 3.333, I would like to use 3.333 directly. Currently, I use the math operation block with the attached configuration, but when I store the value in an analog memory, I get 3333 instead of 3.333, so I have to work with scaled values like 3333. Thank you in advance.
Hello [user_name], welcome to the forum. Please note that this is an English-speaking forum; kindly write future posts in English. Translation: The [product_name] only supports integer values.

analysis.insight_summary: Users experience limitations with the [product_name] system due to its support for only integer numbers, preventing the direct use of decimal results. This forces users to employ scaling techniques to handle non-integer values, which can add complexity and confusion.
analysis.user_expectations: Users expect to be able to perform and store calculations involving real (decimal) numbers within the [product_name] program without needing to manually scale integer values.
